note: v2. Static mapping keys on Brakeman's `warning_type` field (the documented, human-readable string), NOT `check_name` (the UpperCamelCase class name). Only warning types verified against brakeman warning_types docs are mapped; anything else goes to the 'uncategorized' path in run_static.py for inspection, never silently defaulted. grep_cues are LEADS to confirm in context, not findings. See references/tooling.md and references/owasp-top-10-2025-rails.md.
seeds_note: Do NOT blanket-exclude db/seeds.rb or config/**: real secrets/misconfig live there. Exclude only the noise paths above.

rails_subsystems_ref.note: Subsystems Brakeman/core review under-cover but a review pass CAN reach. For multi-tenant apps, review multi-tenancy FIRST — it's usually the highest real risk and is invisible to static tools.

version_gated_rules.note: These rules are false positives on modern stacks unless the version check fails. run_static.py emits detected ruby/rails versions; gate on them.
version_gated_rules.yaml_load: YAML.load is safe_load by default on Psych 4 (Ruby >= 3.1). Only flag YAML.load if Ruby < 3.1 OR the call is YAML.unsafe_load / Psych.unsafe_load / Marshal.load.
version_gated_rules.open_redirect: redirect_to of user input is default-blocked on Rails >= 7.0 NEW apps (raise_on_open_redirects). Flag only if Rails < 7.0, OR config.action_controller.raise_on_open_redirects is not true (upgraded apps that never opted in), OR allow_other_host: true is passed with user input.

categories.name: Broken Access Control
categories.grep_cue_notes: Open-redirect cues are version-gated (see version_gated_rules.open_redirect). SSRF cues (URI.open / HTTP clients on user input) are inspection-only — Brakeman's documented warning types do NOT include a stable SSRF type, so never expect it from the static map.
inspection_only: IDOR via correctly-typed but unscoped find
admin/Sidekiq/Flipper/PgHero mounts without auth in routes.rb
SSRF: user-controlled outbound URL without resolve-and-pin host allow-list (see field guide for DNS-rebinding note)

MULTI-TENANCY: cross-tenant query not scoped through tenant association; default_scope relied on for tenancy (bypassable); CurrentAttributes not reset per request; cross-tenant cache keys (subsystems.md §1)
ActiveStorage: remote-URL attach SSRF, content-type spoofing, direct-upload/blob-attach authz (subsystems.md §2)
ActionCable: channel subscribed/stream_for without ownership check (subsystems.md §5)
Caching: fragment/HTTP caches not keyed by viewer/tenant (subsystems.md §6)

categories.name: Security Misconfiguration
categories.grep_cue_notes: CORS is inspection-only: Brakeman has no CORS warning type. Header/CSP posture is inspection-only or an external check against a running host.
inspection_only: committed secret_key_base / example creds shipped to prod

categories.name: Software Supply Chain Failures
categories.dedup_note: bundler-audit CVE advisories and Brakeman 'Unmaintained Dependencies' can both fire on the same gem — dedup by gem name, keep the CVE (higher signal).

categories.name: Cryptographic Failures
categories.grep_cue_notes: rand( is a broad lead: flag only when the value is used as a security token/secret; SecureRandom.rand and non-security rand are fine. (No lookbehind — filter in review, not in the pattern.)
inspection_only: passwords not via has_secure_password (bcrypt) / argon2 gem
sensitive attrs not using ActiveRecord encrypts / Lockbox

categories.name: Injection
categories.grep_cue_notes: The `format: { with: /^ ... $/ }` cue is the anchor bug (Format Validation): ^ and $ match line boundaries, so a newline bypasses validation — use \A and \z. Brakeman also flags this as Format Validation.
inspection_only: LIKE-wildcard injection: parameterized query still needs sanitize_sql_like on the term

categories.name: Insecure Design
categories.grep_cue_notes: Brakeman 'Denial of Service' (e.g. symbol/regex DoS) maps here as a resource-exhaustion design gap; it has no cleaner Top 10:2025 home. Most of A06 is reasoning, not tools.
inspection_only: no rate limiting/rack-attack on auth/reset/expensive endpoints

categories.name: Authentication Failures
inspection_only: tokens generated with rand instead of SecureRandom

categories.name: Software or Data Integrity Failures
categories.grep_cue_notes: YAML.load is NOT cued here on modern stacks — it is safe_load by default on Psych 4 (Ruby >= 3.1). Cue the genuinely-unsafe unsafe_load / Marshal.load. See version_gated_rules.yaml_load.
inspection_only: webhook controller acting on payload without HMAC signature verification (Stripe/GitHub/Twilio/Shopify)
trust-bearing values in unsigned cookies (use cookies.signed/.encrypted)
ActiveJob: untrusted data into job args that get deserialized; Marshal-based Rails cache with a writable store (subsystems.md §3, §6)

categories.name: Security Logging & Alerting Failures
inspection_only: no audit log on sensitive models

categories.name: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
categories.grep_cue_notes: Broad multiline rescues (rescue => e followed by an empty/permissive body) are NOT reliably grep-able line-by-line — run these with `rg -U` (multiline) or review rescue blocks in auth/authz/payment paths by hand. Brakeman 'Divide By Zero' is a concrete unhandled-exception signal mapped here.
inspection_only: TOCTOU/race without DB constraint or lock
